evidence: Changes CMake build system, CI configuration (.github/ci-windows.py, .github/workflows/ci.yml), and compiler requirements for native Windows builds, bearing 'Build system' and 'Windows' labels.
rationale: Switching native Windows builds to clang-cl cuts Windows CI build time by ~38%, improves benchmarked validation performance by ~55%, and eliminates persistent MSVC compiler bug workarounds. The author notes that 'ConnectBlockAllEcdsa improving from 7.40 to 11.52 block/s (~55%)' and CI time drops from 20m 35s to 12m 43s while retiring multiple MSVC workarounds (#31456, #36153).
